caseName: Lampkin-Asam v. Miami Daily News, Inc.
caseNameFull: Lampkin-Asam v. Miami Daily News, Inc., dba The Miami News

opinions.text: Appeal from Dist. Ct. App. Fla., 3d Dist., dismissed for want of jurisdiction. Treating the papers whereon the appeal was taken as a petition for writ of certiorari, certiorari denied.
